name: Award Of Stipend To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In ITI
benefit: Maintenance Allowance from Rs.40/- to Rs.100/- per month for 10 months is provided through the concerned I.T.I.
_eligibility_text: 1. Students should belong to V.J.N.T. or S.B.C category. 1. Students should be trainees of approved I.T.I. 1. The parent/Guardian's income should be up to ₹ 65290/- per year. 1. The selection process is completed by the Principal of the concerned ITI.
